purpose: Restore the production staff control plane by making its server-side Web-to-API authority consistent with the already-governed REG.RU Docker Compose authority without weakening browser-origin, CSRF, MFA, role or tenant controls.
requiredInvariants: Explicit server-side API_URL remains highest priority.
Production plaintext HTTP is accepted only for the exact canonical Compose authority http://api:3001 and never for a suffix, alternate port, credentials, query, fragment or path-bearing variant.
When API_URL is absent in production, the only fallback is the exact canonical Compose authority http://api:3001.
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is never production server authority.

Existing canonical control-host enforcement, exact-origin CSRF, double-submit token validation, MFA requirements, staff route allowlists, bearer secrecy, redirect refusal and server-side role/tenant authority remain unchanged.
No database, RLS, password, TOTP, staff assignment, DNS, Caddy, Compose, SSH pin, secret or production mutation is introduced by this branch.
Merge and CI success are not production acceptance.
acceptance: Production exact http://api:3001 is accepted and production fallback resolves to exactly http://api:3001.
Arbitrary plaintext origins, lookalike hosts, credentials in URLs, non-http schemes, query and fragment authorities fail closed.
An explicit HTTPS server authority remains accepted.
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL remains available only outside production.
Staff SSR identity verification, capabilities BFF and bounded staff proxy use one shared resolver.
Focused unit regression and existing staff control-plane boundary tests pass on the exact branch head.
Production remains unchanged until governed exact-current-main release through issue 3072.
